title: achasma sphaerocephalum
intro: Achasma sphaerocephalum, commonly known as Globe-headed Achasma, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae. Globe-headed Achasma is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Globe-headed Achasma are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, which can help relieve symptoms of urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Globe-headed Achasma include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
